Op. 0010T79 HOOD HYDRAULIC SYSTEM - DISCHARGE AND RESTORE PRESSURE

1. Using the electric control, place the 5th arc (1a) in the raised position (as illustrated), the hood housing cover (1b) in the fully raised position and the side covers (flaps) (1c) in a lowered position (as illustrated).

1. Working on the side cover (1a) involved, left or right, rotate the release retainer (1b) in the direction of the arrow (1c) until it is in the unlocked position (1d).

2. Rotate the side cover (1a) upwards until it is in position (2a), then secure it using adhesive bodywork tape.

1. Using a screwdriver, release the retaining clip (1a) from the end of the hydraulic actuator (without removing it).

2. Disconnect the lower end of the telescopic strut, releasing it from the ball joint.

3. Release the side trim rear retaining buttons using the special tool.
